newsitem.title: FRANCE: Explosion hits Paris mosque, injures one.
newsitem.headline: Explosion hits Paris mosque, injures one.

text.p: An explosion rocked a Mosque in the French capital Paris early on Monday, slightly injuring one man, rescue workers said.
The blast damaged the entrance of the Mosque and shattered windows in neighbouring buildings in the Rue Tanger. The wounded man, believed to be the guard of the Mosque, was taken to hospital.
Police were trying to determine the cause of the explosion. Rescue workers said that an explosive device had apparently been placed in front of the building.
